units.title: Implement the typed pre-write evaluator and native adapters
units.objective: Produce attributable allow, observe-violation, and deny decisions for supported native pre-write events without changing host configuration.

included: Strict request, decision, and receipt contracts
Claim/session/worktree/branch/path policy evaluation
Claude and Codex payload adapters
Claim-bound cache and both-sign deterministic tests

outputs: Typed ownership evaluator and bounded cache
Claude and Codex pre-write adapters with both-sign fixtures

acceptance.criterion: Supported native pre-write fixtures produce exact attributable decisions and cannot reuse an allow after claim or branch identity changes.
evidence_required: pytest -q tests/test_prewrite_claim_gate.py
ruff and strict mypy on the evaluator and CLI
git diff --check
acceptance.negative_control: Missing, wrong-session, wrong-worktree, wrong-branch, out-of-scope, unhealthy, malformed, and unknown supported-write fixtures deny in enforce mode without mutating the fixture target.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim for this ready unit and its declared repository paths.

units.title: Compile and consume a low-latency claim authority projection
units.objective: Keep YAML claims authoritative while making each fresh native hook decision from an exact digest-bound projection fast enough for the approved latency gate.

included: Atomic digest-bound projection of canonical normalized live claims
Dependency-light native hook evaluator behind the existing decision contract
Projection refresh on every sanctioned claim mutation and explicit recovery command
Canonical-versus-fast parity, corruption, staleness, lifecycle, and latency fixtures
excluded: A second claim authority or permissive fallback
Arbitrary shell or operating-system write containment

outputs: PreWriteAuthorityProjectionV1 and atomically generated local projection
One dependency-light decision engine shared by the typed facade and native CLI
Deterministic projection refresh and fail-loud stale-state recovery

dependencies.rationale: The fast path must preserve the accepted request, decision, receipt, and policy semantics.

acceptance.criterion: The dependency-light engine and typed canonical facade return equivalent reason codes and decisions for exact, missing, ambiguous, wrong-session, wrong-repository, wrong-worktree, wrong-branch, out-of-scope, stale-heartbeat, expired, merged, missing-worktree, corrupt-projection, and digest-mismatch fixtures.
evidence_required: Failing tests committed or demonstrated before implementation
pytest -q tests/test_prewrite_claim_gate.py tests/test_prewrite_claim_projection.py tests/test_check_coordination_claims.py
ruff and strict mypy on changed Python files
acceptance.negative_control: A missing, corrupt, or digest-mismatched projection is an observe violation or enforce denial and never invokes the slow YAML evaluator as a fallback.

acceptance.criterion: The unchanged full fresh-process calibration classifies 50 authorized and 10 violation controls with zero false blocks at p95 below 100 ms and p99 below 200 ms.
evidence_required: Versioned calibration JSON with all 60 receipt IDs and exact command/config identity
Aggregate latency plus step-down to each concrete decision receipt
python scripts/self_test.py and git diff --check
acceptance.negative_control: Mutating a claim after projection generation invalidates the next authorization until an explicit canonical refresh succeeds.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim for this ready unit and every declared repository path.

units.title: Wire observe mode and calibrate correctness and latency
units.objective: Install preserving observe-mode wiring, retain concrete decision receipts, and determine whether hard enforcement can meet the approved correctness and latency bars.

included: Preserving hook generator and governed-repo audit
Explicit observe-mode configuration
Deterministic latency calibration and representative live payload receipts
Operator documentation and rollback

outputs: Idempotent observe-mode hook wiring and audit

dependencies.rationale: Live calibration must use the accepted evaluator and adapter contract.
Observe-mode promotion must use the accepted low-latency path rather than the known slow YAML path.

conflict_surfaces.target: explicitly reviewed local client hook configuration

acceptance.criterion: Observe-mode wiring preserves unrelated hooks, never blocks, and emits attributable receipts whose local evaluator latency is p95 below 100 ms and p99 below 200 ms with zero false-block classifications on representative compliant writes.
evidence_required: Hook-wiring and governed-audit tests
Deterministic calibration JSON with concrete receipt IDs
Representative native-client observe receipts
Idempotent second installation dry run
acceptance.negative_control: Malformed identity and unclaimed/out-of-scope writes remain observable violations rather than being silently allowed as authorized.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-01 accepted and exact host or repository write surfaces declared in a fresh claim.

units.title: Make every active sanctioned claim writer refresh the authority projection
units.objective: Inventory the active claim-mutation entrypoints, update each governed installed copy to the accepted projection-refreshing implementation, and prove create, heartbeat, release, and session closeout cannot leave the shared projection stale.

included: Read-only inventory of active sanctioned claim-mutation entrypoints
Explicit claimed updates to their installed coordination runtime copies
Create, heartbeat, release, and closeout projection-current readbacks
A retained fleet version/digest and mutation evidence report
excluded: Adding a resident daemon or a slow hook fallback
Changing claim authority away from the YAML registry

outputs: Authoritative inventory of active claim mutation surfaces and installed revisions
Projection-refreshing runtime on every active sanctioned mutation surface

dependencies.rationale: Fleet mutation rollout must use the accepted installed observe implementation.

conflict_surfaces.target: active governed repositories that provide sanctioned claim-mutation entrypoints
shared claim registry and digest-bound projection

acceptance.criterion: Every active sanctioned claim-mutation entrypoint is either updated to the accepted projection-refreshing revision or explicitly removed from active use, and create, heartbeat, release, and closeout probes each leave projection_is_current true.
evidence_required: Fleet inventory with canonical repository identity and installed source digest
Per-repository claimed update or explicit inactive disposition
Four mutation receipts with projection digest readback
Post-probe native observe allow with no projection_unavailable_or_stale result
acceptance.negative_control: A deliberately retained legacy fixture is detected as noncompliant and cannot satisfy the promotion guard.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-02 accepted; claim the framework inventory/report paths and obtain an exact claim in every target repository before updating its installed runtime.

units.title: Promote one governed repository to hard pre-write enforcement
units.objective: Enable enforcement only after accepted calibration, then prove unauthorized native writes are stopped before mutation and exact claimed writes still succeed.

included: One explicitly selected governed repository
Exact enforce-mode configuration change
Real positive and negative file-hash probes
Rollback and retained receipts

outputs: Positive and negative native write receipts

dependencies.rationale: Hard enforcement is permitted only after the observe-mode correctness and latency bars pass.
Hard enforcement would create intermittent false denials while any active claim writer can leave the shared projection stale.

conflict_surfaces.target: one explicitly selected governed repository hook configuration

acceptance.criterion: An unclaimed or out-of-scope native edit is denied with unchanged target hash, while the same edit under an exact healthy claim succeeds and the rollback returns the repository to observe mode.
evidence_required: Real native negative-control receipt and unchanged before/after hash
Real native positive-control receipt and expected diff
Rollback readback
Relevant regression suite
acceptance.negative_control: A missing registry, malformed identity, or stale claim must not be converted into an allow decision in enforce mode.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-02 and PW-02B accepted and the target repository/configuration paths declared in a fresh exact claim.
